description: Source code for the mod_dirlisting plugin of lighttpd, implementing directory listing functionality with sorting, filtering, and HTML generation.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Configuration options for the directory listing plugin, including display preferences, sorting, and cache settings.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main plugin data structure holding configuration and processing state.

classes.name: dirls_entry_t
classes.description: Represents a directory entry with name length, modification time, and size.

classes.name: handler_ctx
classes.description: Context for handling directory listing requests, including directory streams, file lists, and buffers.

methods.name: mod_dirlisting_handler_ctx_init
methods.description: Initializes a handler context for directory listing.

methods.name: mod_dirlisting_handler_ctx_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a handler context.

methods.name: mod_dirlisting_parse_cache
methods.description: Parses cache configuration for directory listing.

methods.name: mod_dirlisting_exclude
methods.description: Determines if a filename should be excluded based on configured patterns.

methods.name: mod_dirlisting_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin.

methods.name: http_list_directory_sizefmt
methods.description: Formats file size into human-readable string.

methods.name: http_list_directory_include_file
methods.description: Includes a file (readme or header) into the directory listing HTML.

methods.name: http_dirlist_link
methods.description: Adds a link header for early hints.

methods.name: http_dirlist_auto_layout_early_hints
methods.description: Adds preload links for external CSS and JS.

methods.name: http_list_directory_header
methods.description: Generates the HTML header for directory listing page.

methods.name: http_list_directory_ent
methods.description: Outputs a directory entry in HTML.
